title: SCADA Inputs Configuration
description: List of the commands that can be sent through the SCADA

destination.description: Cyber node to which the command will be sent

equipmentId.description: IIDM equipment the command drives, given for the commands the asset simulator answers

kind.description: Type of setpoint, given alongside equipmentId

simulator.description: Simulator this entry belongs to; the orchestrator only drives the dynawo ones. 'automaton' for a command answered by an automaton (e.g. a button the automaton listens to)
